description_en: Retrieves a list of data sources that match the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 根据数据源业务信息，查询符合的数据源列表
name: ListDataSources

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source. Fuzzy match by data source name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称，基于此名称做模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The data source types. This parameter specifies a filter condition. You can specify multiple data source types
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型查询过滤，可以配置多个类型查询过滤
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the data sources are used. Valid values:

Dev: development environment

Prod: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
数据源环境类型，枚举值：
Dev：开发环境
Prod：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页，默认值为1表示第一页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大值100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field that you want to use to sort the data sources. Valid values:

CreateTime

Id

Name

Default value: CreateTime
parameters.help_zh:
数据源列表排序字段，支持名称、创建时间、数据源ID排序
CreateTime：创建时间
Id：数据源ID
Name：数据源名称

默认值：CreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the data sources. Valid values:

Desc: descending order

Asc: ascending order

Default value: Desc
parameters.help_zh:
数据源列表排序方向，枚举值：
Desc：倒序
Asc：正序

默认值：Desc
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The tag of the data source. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

You can specify multiple tags, which are in the logical AND relation. For example, you can query the data sources that contain the following tags: `["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"]`.

If you do not configure this parameter, tag-based filtering is not performed. You can specify up to 10 tags
parameters.help_zh:
数据源可以打标签，基于标签做数据源查询过滤：
多个值之间是“且”的关系，比如`["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"]`底层查询同时有这3个标签打标的数据源列表。
不传递，或者传递为空表示不作tag过滤，查询最多支持10个标签
parameters.name: tags

DataSources.description_en: The data source groups. Each element in the array indicates a data source group. Each data source group contains data sources in the development environment (if any) and the production environment
DataSources.description_zh: 数据源列表，每一个元素是一个数据源组，包含开发环境（如有）和生产环境的信息

items.description_en: The information about the data source group, including data sources in the development environment (if any) and the production environment. Data sources in the development environment and the production environment have the same data source name and data source type, but different data source IDs
items.description_zh: 数据源组信息，包含开发环境（如有）和生产环境的数据源。开发环境和生产环境的数据源具有相同的数据源名称和数据源类型，不相同的数据源ID

DataSource.description_en: The data sources. Each element is the information of a single data source with a unique data source ID
DataSource.description_zh: 数据源列表，每个元素是单个数据源信息，具有唯一的数据源ID

items.description_en: The information about the data source

ConnectionProperties.description_en:
The connection configurations of the data source, including the connection address, access identity, and environment information. The envType parameter specifies the environment in which the data source is used. Valid values of the envType parameter:

Dev: development environment

Prod: production environment

The parameters that you need to configure for the data source vary based on the mode in which the data source is added. For more information, see [Data source connection information (ConnectionProperties)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html）
ConnectionProperties.description_zh:
数据源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。数据源环境envType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）

不同类型的数据源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，请参考[数据源连接信息ConnectionProperties]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html）

ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_en:
The mode in which the data source is added. The mode varies based on the data source type. Valid values:

InstanceMode: instance mode

UrlMode: connection string mode
ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_zh:
数据源添加的类别，不同type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，场景举例：
InstanceMode 实例模式。
UrlMode 连接串模式

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the data source was added. This value is a UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 数据源的创建时间（时间戳）

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the user who adds the data source

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source
Id.description_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp
ModifyTime.description_zh: 数据源的最近修改时间（时间戳）

ModifyUser.description_en: The ID of the user who modifies the data source

QualifiedName.description_en: The unique business key of the data source. For example, the unique business key of a Hologres data source is in the `${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}` format
QualifiedName.description_zh: 数据源的业务唯一键，以holo举例格式是`${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}`

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

Type.description_en: The type of the data source

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
